observations: The page number «58» stands at the head of the page, centred, with a rule below it. The page has no signature. L01-L07 end chapter 14 (pp. 56-57, JP2 0088-0089). L08-L09 and L26-L27: the headings of chapters 15 and 16, in bold, centred, each with the reference to the text below it.

L10-L25: the obliquity of the ecliptic: al-Khwārizmī 23° 51′, the Sūrya-Siddhānta 24°, the «tested tables» 23° 33′, Ptolemy 23° 51′ 20″, al-Battānī 23° 35′. Ptolemy's value is half of the 47° 42′ 40″ between the tropics of Almagest I, 12; L18: «vergl. oben p. 33» refers to Ibn al-Qifṭī's report that al-Khwārizmī took the declination of the sun after Ptolemy (p. 33, JP2 0065, L03-L08). The declinations of Tables 21-26 are to be compared with the tables.

L21: «sin δ = sin l · sin e», δ, l and e in italics, «sin» upright, «·» the raised dot of multiplication; L29-L30: the rule for the latitude of the moon in italics, «×» the sign of multiplication, «=» upright.

L33-L37. Checked: the tables of the node give 360° less its longitude (p. 55, JP2 0087, L10-L13), so that the tabulated value added to the true longitude of the moon, 360° cast off when the sum exceeds it, is the true longitude of the moon less that of the node, the argument of latitude of al-Battānī's second rule. L33: the r of «Drachenkopfes» is printed without its arm; see the critical note. L34: the passage in square brackets, which note 2 says al-Khwārizmī does not have.

L17: the prime of «51′» in «23° 51′ 20″» is a heavier sort than the other primes of the page. N01: a speck above the point after «201»; not transcribed. Spaced type, marked {sp:}: «Kh.», «Batt.», «Ptol.», «Burgess», «Nallino»; italics: «Statio prima», «mittlere Centrum», «Centrum aequatum», «Porta», «bāb», «Obliquatio solis», «mail al-shams», «accedentis», «ascendentis», «recedentis», «descendentis», «grösste Deklination», «Schiefe der Ekliptik», «Sūrya-Siddhānta», «Argument der Breite» (L32).
The colons and semicolons stand after the thin space of the edition (9-14 px measured).
